## Description

Maps stock universe cointegration network graphs into Maximum-Cut (Max-Cut) problems solved using parameterized quantum circuits (QAOA) to identify market-neutral cluster pairs.

## Where it may fit

Large equity universes (S&P 500 / Russell 1000), statistical arbitrage cluster selection during regime shifts.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Hedge Funds, Quantitative Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

Daily and intraday return matrices, cointegration test p-values, correlation adjacency matrices.

## Caveats

NISQ circuit depth limitations require statevector simulation or classical QAOA approximations for large asset universes.
